The target ray passes, but the frame communicates the endpoint mass more clearly than the full bridge silhouette; this is retained as a review-harness weakness rather than silently called conclusive evidence.
All twelve room stacks are visibly roof-sealed and the roof families vary without missing gable sides.

findings.evidence: The camera is collision-clear and its 1.0 visibility fraction passes the hard target gate, but full-resolution inspection shows that endpoint facades dominate the frame and the complete horizontal silhouette is not legible.
findings.invariant: A closing visual corpus should communicate the named construction relationship, not merely produce an unobstructed ray to one sampled target face.
